fusions.name: Crust Toss
fusions.desc: Tosses a crust that deals 7 water damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds. You heal for 12% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: The Whole Loaf
fusions.desc: Lobs a loaf that deals 28 water damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts for 80% of that on every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves what it hits [Soaked] for 6 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Bottoms Up
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 3% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
